article.title: James Madison squares off against UConn in Week 11
article.linkText: James Madison squares off against UConn in Week 11
article.story: James Madison (8-2) at UConn (4-5), Nov. 14 at 12 p.m. EST. Opening Line: James Madison by 3. Against the spread: James Madison 7-3, UConn 5-4. How to watch: CBS Sports Network Key stats James Madison Offense Overall: 455.6 yards per game (16th in FBS) Passing: 256.3 yards per game (33rd) Rushing: 199.3 yards per game (25th) Scoring: 40.6 points per game (7th) James Madison Defense Overall: 352.4 yards per game (62nd in FBS) Passing: 238.5 yards per game (109th) Rushing: 113.9 yards per game (29th) Scoring: 19.3 points per game (27th) UConn Offense Overall: 431.7 yards per game (30th in FBS) Passing: 246.7 yards per game (42nd) Rushing: 185.0 yards per game (35th) Scoring: 32.9 points per game (38th) UConn Defense Overall: 392.6 yards per game (101st in FBS) Passing: 249.8 yards per game (120th) Rushing: 142.8 yards per game (70th) Scoring: 26.7 points per game (87th) Both teams are heavily penalized. James Madison ranks 129th in the FBS averaging 75.2 penalty yards per game, and UConn ranks 122nd with a 71.9-yard average. UConn ranks 117th in FBS in red zone defense, allowing opponents to score on 90.6% of trips. James Madison's red zone offense ranks 8th, scoring on 94.1% of red zone opportunities. Both teams rank low in time of possession. James Madison is 114th in the FBS with an average time of possession of 28:14, while UConn's 127th-ranked average is 27:28. Team leaders James Madison Passing: Camden Coleman, 1,815 yards, 17 TDs, 4 INTs, 62.0 completion percentage Rushing: George Pettaway, 812 yards on 125 carries, 8 TDs Receiving: Ja'Corey Scott, 507 yards on 33 catches, 5 TDs UConn Passing: Kalieb Osborne, 2,102 yards, 16 TDs, 4 INTs, 58.4 completion percentage Rushing: Cyncir Bowers, 639 yards on 97 carries, 8 TDs Receiving: Ryder Treadway, 346 yards on 24 catches, 2 TDs Last game James Madison won 54-23 over Southern Miss on Nov. 5. J.C. Evans led James Madison with 251 yards on 19-of-26 passing (73.1%) for one touchdown and no interceptions. He also carried the ball 13 times for 47 yards and three rushing touchdowns. Seth Cromwell had 56 rushing yards on 10 carries, adding four receptions for 40 yards and one touchdown. Scott put up 121 yards on six catches. UConn lost 38-21 to North Carolina on Nov. 7. Osborne led UConn with 245 yards on 17-of-35 passing (48.6%) for two touchdowns and two interceptions. He also carried the ball 11 times for 28 yards. Bowers had 68 rushing yards on 13 carries and one touchdown. Treadway had four receptions for 82 yards and one touchdown. Next game James Madison hosts Coastal Carolina on Nov. 28. UConn hosts Old Dominion on Nov. 21.
